title: Senior Associate - Acquisition Support Specialist
description:

Blake Willson Group (BWG) unites deep domain experts with technologists who leverage industry-leading financial management solutions to address the most critical mission objectives. Headquartered in the National Capital Region, the firm delivers measurable outcomes through technology-forward strategies and advanced solutions that drive mission success.

Blake Willson Group has a distinguished track record of exceptional performance, achieving operational efficiencies that allow our clients to do more with less. BWG has earned the confidence of its clients by consistently exceeding expectations through its unwavering commitment to best value solutions, implemented with speed.

Job Location:
This role is 100% remote.
Clearance:
Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust Security Clearance.
Job Description:
Blake Willson Group is seeking an Acquisition Support Specialist to support federal procurements throughout the acquisition lifecycle, from acquisition planning through contract closeout. In this role, you will develop and review acquisition documentation, research federal acquisition requirements, monitor procurement milestones, and coordinate with contracting, program, finance, legal, and other stakeholders to support timely and compliant acquisition outcomes. In this position, you will:

• Independently support federal procurements from acquisition planning through contract award, administration, and closeout.

• Advise program offices on acquisition strategies, procurement documentation, timelines, risks, and regulatory requirements.

• Develop and review Acquisition Plans, Market Research Reports, SOWs, PWSs, SOOs, IGCEs, Source Selection Plans, Determinations and Findings, and Justifications and Approvals.

• Develop and review RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, and other solicitation documents while ensuring procurement packages and acquisition files are complete, accurate, and compliant.

• Research the FAR, agency supplements, and procurement policies and provide recommendations regarding acquisition and contract administration issues.

• Support proposal and quotation evaluations, including technical, management, past performance, and price documentation, as well as negotiation documentation and award recommendations.

• Support contract awards, task orders, modifications, funding actions, option exercises, and administrative changes while monitoring schedules and identifying risks to procurement milestones.

• Coordinate with Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, CORs, program managers, financial personnel, legal counsel, and other stakeholders; prepare reports, briefings, trackers, and management communications; and provide guidance and quality reviews to junior acquisition staff.

Required Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Acquisition Management, Contract Management, or a related field.

• 4 years of experience supporting federal acquisitions, preferably as a Federal Contract Specialist, Acquisition Specialist, Procurement Analyst, Contracting Officer support professional, or in a similar role.

• 2 years of experience developing and reviewing federal acquisition documentation and supporting competitive procurements.

Desired Skills:

• Prior experience as a Federal Contract Specialist, Contracting Officer, Procurement Analyst, Acquisition Specialist, or in a similar role.

• Experience working within a federal procurement or contracting office.

• FAC-C Professional, DAWIA Contracting, or equivalent acquisition certification or training.

• Experience with GSA Schedules, GWACs, IDIQ contracts, BPAs, and task or delivery orders.

• Experience supporting source selections, proposal evaluations, acquisition planning, price analysis, or contract administration.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

•

•

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Based Marketing Manager with vertical experience in Financial Services to design and execute highly targeted, data-driven ABM programs for our top strategic accounts-driving pipeline growth, accelerating deals, and increasing customer lifetime value. This role will focus on high-impact campaigns aligned to the Financial Services industry, leveraging industry-specific insights to personalize the buyer journey and deepen executive engagement.

This is a hands-on, strategic role that blends Financial Services vertical expertise, ABM strategy and execution, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of Financial Services industry pain points, collaborates closely with sales and marketing teams, and thrives in a high-growth, customer-centric environment.

• 10+ years of B2B field marketing experience, with at least 5+ years focused on ABM and/or strategic account marketing in enterprise tech or SaaS environments.

• Proven vertical marketing expertise-ideally in Financial Services-with the ability to speak to industry-specific trends, buyer needs, and GTM motions.

• Advanced proficiency in ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase), Salesforce CRM, and analytics tools such as Tableau.

• Strong understanding of the customer journey, multi-touch attribution, and end-to-end campaign development.

• Excellent project management and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working across sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.

• Experience enabling sales teams with tailored messaging and account-based strategies.

• Team mentorship or leadership experience is a plus.

Success Metrics

• Pipeline contribution and acceleration from strategic vertical accounts

If you're empathetic, solutions-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!
What You'll Do:

•
Be the voice of BloomNation: Provide friendly, efficient, and accurate Tier 1 support to our customers and floral partners via phone and email.

•
Problem-solve with a smile: Listen to customer inquiries, diagnose issues, and provide helpful solutions.

•
Escalate when necessary: Accurately identify and escalate complex technical issues to our engineering team.

Become a product expert: Help customers and partners maximize their use of BloomNation's platform to grow their businesses.

What You'll Bring:

A natural knack for connecting with people: You're a friendly, optimistic, and caring individual who loves building relationships.

•
Passion for small businesses: You're excited to support local florists and be part of a growing startup.

•
Tech-savviness: You're comfortable learning and using various support tools (experience Salesforce or similar platforms is a plus!).

•
Exceptional communication skills: You can clearly and effectively communicate both in writing and over the phone.

•
Bilingual: Spanish speaking is a plus!

•
Grace under pressure: You can work efficiently and maintain a positive attitude in a fast-paced environment.

•
Customer service experience: Previous experience in a customer-facing role (retail or service industry experience is a big plus!) is highly valued.

More about us - Promenade

Promenade is a mission-driven company empowering local businesses with products and services that allow them to thrive online and offline. We build vertically-focused software catered to each industry we serve, leveling the playing field between the small business and large aggregators. Promenade was originally founded in 2011 as BloomNation, the nation’s premier network for local florists, disrupting the multi-billion dollar floral industry. After helping thousands of local florists across the country, we doubled down on our mission and began helping more small businesses who carried the same challenges of acquiring and retaining their own customers. Today, Promenade creates software for four industries - BloomNation (Floral), Promenade (Food, Liquor and Butchers) . The company is based in Santa Monica, CA along with Remote roles.
Additional highlights…
Backed by premier industry investors such as Andreessen Horowitz (AirBnB, Box, Facebook, Lyft, Twitter, etc.), Spark Capital (Tumblr, Upworthy, Warby Parker, etc.), and Crunch Fund (Square, Uber, etc.)
Named one of Entrepreneur’s “5 Sizzling Silicon Beach Startups to Watch”

Located one block away from the beach on the world-famous 3rd Street Promenade in Santa Monica
Why join Promenade ?
If you want a front-row seat in seeing a company disrupt a massive industry and you love the idea of helping hardworking business owners that serve our local communities and neighborhoods, this is your place. At Promenade , everyone has a voice to create change and move the needle. No hierarchy, no bureaucracy, no politics...just real people working on solving real problems.

title: Lead Environmental Qualification Engineer 1 - Nuclear
description:
Responsibilities
This is a senior engineering position that offers a variety of interesting and challenging opportunities in component qualification engineering and will provide an excellent opportunity to advance your career. You will collaborate with a team including other component qualification engineers, interface with engineers from other disciplines, and guide the work of less experienced project team members.
You will work with an engineering team on projects for license renewals and upgrades/modifications to nuclear power plants in the following areas:

• This position will offer you the ability to directly apply your knowledge of component environmental qualification for 10CFR 50.49 equipment.

• As a member of an engineering team, you will work on a wide range of projects for various clients. You will prepare and review calculations, review qualification reports from vendors, develop specifications, revise client design basis documents and support EQ-related inquiries from clients.

• Perform Environmental Qualification qualified life assessments using the Arrhenius method and updates to other qualification documentation

• Perform Linear Regression analysis to determine activation energies

• Coordination of EQ testing at various testing facilities

• Provide and coordinate resolution of anomalies with sites and test facilities

• Equipment material suitability analysis

• Review of Maintenance and Surveillance requirements

• EPU and postulated accident effects on equipment

• Radiation dose effects on EQ equipment due to fuel and fuel cycle changes

• There is the potential for travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for construction coordination and field verification of designs.

Qualifications
We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.
Essential skills and experience:

• Bachelor of Science (BS) in engineering degree with emphasis in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering from an ABET-accredited program

• Ten (10) or more years of experience related to component environmental qualification activities in the nuclear power plant industry

• Knowledge of nuclear power plant equipment functionality, materials of construction, failure modes, etc.

• Familiarity with NRC IE Notices, Bulletins, Generic Letters

• Familiarity with industry DOR plant requirements, 10CFR Part 50.49, 10CFR Part 21, Regulatory Guides, NUREG and EPRI Documents, IEEE 323, IEEE 383, IEEE 334, IEEE 317 and other IEEE Standards applicable to environmental qualification.

• Proficiency with MS Office applications

• Good written and verbal communication skills

Valued, but not required:

• PE license

title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
description: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 - Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.

title: Basispsycholoog - SGGZ - Thuiswerken
description:
Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland
Ben jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Heb je al minimaal twee jaar vlieguren gemaakt binnen de SGGZ en wil je jouw expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving?
Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.
Wij zoeken proactieve basispsychologen die online behandelen serieus nemen. Professionals die digitaal vaardig zijn, stevig in hun rol staan en ook op afstand een sterke behandelrelatie kunnen opbouwen.
Over Beterggz
Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.
Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters en andere betrokken professionals. We werken digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief goede GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.
Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je zit. Of je nu vanuit Nederland werkt of vanuit het buitenland, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit op orde zijn.
Requirements
Wat ga je doen?
Als online basispsycholoog behandel je cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ. Je voert online behandelgesprekken, doet psychodiagnostiek, stelt samen met collega’s behandelplannen op en bewaakt de voortgang van de behandeling.
Je werkt zelfstandig, maar niet geïsoleerd. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een digitaal multidisciplinair team waarin je afstemt met regiebehandelaren, psychiaters en collega-psychologen. Ook denk je actief mee over de kwaliteit van onze zorg, kennisdeling en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.
De functie vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt, zorgvuldig rapporteert, risico’s tijdig signaleert en professioneel blijft handelen bij complexe zorgvragen.
Wie zoeken wij?
Wij zoeken geen starter, maar een zelfstandige basispsycholoog met minimaal twee jaar ervaring binnen de SGGZ. Je hebt een afgeronde master Psychologie, beschikt over een LOGO-verklaring en hebt aantoonbare scholing in Cognitieve Gedragstherapie, CGT.
Je bent gewend om professioneel en gestructureerd te werken, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een digitale werkomgeving. Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.
Ervaring of scholing in ACT, EMDR en schematherapie vinden wij waardevol. Dit is geen harde eis, maar wel een duidelijke pre. Datzelfde geldt voor ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en andere complexe zorgvragen binnen de SGGZ.
Verder is het belangrijk dat je uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Engels kunnen spreken is mooi meegenomen.
Waarom Beterggz?
Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en goede online zorg kunt leveren.
We werken op ZZP-basis met een uurtarief van €70 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we samen af en starten kan op korte termijn.
Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de kans om inhoudelijk sterk werk te doen én mee te bouwen aan een moderne manier van GGZ-zorg leveren.
Interesse?
Lijkt het je interessant om als online basispsycholoog bij Beterggz aan de slag te gaan?

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.
Een VOG-verklaring maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Frankfurt
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented Product Operations Intern to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Product Feedback & Prioritization

• Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.

• Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.

• Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions.

Documentation & Process Improvement

• Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales.

• Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses.

title: Information Security Architect
description:
At Unit4 , we’re in Business for People. The Global Security organisation protects our people, platforms, products, and customers by driving secure design, resilience, and maturity across the entire business. As we strengthen our architecture capability across CISO, IT, and CloudOps, we are seeking an experienced Security Architect to partner across the enterprise and help shape Unit4 ’s future‑state security landscape.
This role sits within the CISO Security Team but works with Product/Engineering, Enterprise Architecture and CloudOps. You will play a pivotal role in designing, governing, and embedding secure architectural principles across Unit4 ’s technology estate.
Job Description
The Security Architect will develop, and mature Unit4 ’s enterprise security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, identity, SaaS, and endpoint domains. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, guide teams, and translate business strategy and risk into secure, scalable, and pragmatic designs.
This is a hands‑on architectural role for someone who thrives in complex environments, can operate strategically and tactically, and who brings expertise across security architecture, cloud, and modern enterprise platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Security Architecture

• Lead the security target state architecture and multi-year roadmap, aligning risk reduction and business outcomes; socialize tradeoffs with leadership.

• Lead enterprise architecture assessments across multiple environments, including:

• Cloud (Azure) security and network infrastructure, including Kubernetes

• Identity & access management (zero trust, conditional access, PAM/PIM)

• CI/CD pipelines and secure software development

• AI / LLM

• Partner closely with Cloud Ops and Product Architecture to ensure security is designed into enterprise platforms and product roadmaps.

• Develop security reference architectures, and patterns aligned to Unit4 ’s security vision.

• Design and implementation of layered enterprise security architectures, ensuring defence-in-depth and resilience across digital estates.

• Act as a architectural authority in engagements interdepartmentally, providing well reasoned viewpoints on security principles, technologies, and patterns.

• Ensure architectural decisions incorporate regulatory, customer, and audit requirements and are evidenced through pattern adoption and architecture reviews.

• Partner closely with Product/Engineering, Enterprise Architecture and CloudOps to embed security controls, influence technology decisions, and ensure alignment to security strategy.

• Engage with senior stakeholders to shape cyber direction and ensure architectural consistency across teams.

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

• Secure architecture for multi‑cloud environments (Azure primary; awareness of AWS/GCP) across networking, compute, data, containers, and serverless.

• Collaborate on the security design, engineering, and implementation of solutions within the Microsoft 365 (M365) and Entra ID ecosystems.

• Consult on Microsoft security tooling including Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Endpoint management, Azure Network Security, and Conditional Access.

• Evaluate new cloud services, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated before adoption.

Cloud Operations and Product

• Collaborate on the security design for workloads deployed on cloud environments (Microsoft Azure preferred) (IaaS, PaaS, and Serverless), ensuring alignment with corporate security policy and regulatory requirements.

• Develop secure reference architectures for Azure cloud services, covering:

• Container platforms including AKS: cluster governance and baseline policies, workload identity, secrets management, runtime threat detection, tenancy/isolation and scale/cost guardrails.

• Compute: VMs, scale sets, serverless workloads.

• Storage & Data Services: Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, managed databases, key management, data loss prevention.

The Financial Controller is the senior accounting leader for the operating business and its acquired entities. Reporting to corporate finance and partnering with operating leadership, this role manages the full accounting lifecycle, working capital, and acquisition integration.
This hands-on position ensures accurate books, timely closes, system reconciliations, disciplined cash operations, credit risk monitoring, and robust internal controls while delivering operating data to support parent-level reporting and M&A execution.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Close Management

• Own month-end close across multi-entity operations (preliminary financials by Business Day 7; final close by BD 10).

• Coordinate external audit, tax, lender, and regulatory reporting requirements.

Systems & Reconciliations

• Reconcile operational platforms (TMS/operational software), factoring platforms, bank accounts, payroll, and the general ledger (GL).

Payables & Cash Management

• Manage end-to-end accounts payable, aging schedules, and payment runs within approved terms.

Receivables, Factoring & Credit Control

• Oversee billing, cash application, collections, AR aging, and factoring relationship reconciliations.

Acquisition Integration & Corporate Support

• Lead accounting integration for new acquisitions (opening balances, system/bank migrations, payroll, and cut-off controls).

• Supply validated financial data, margin analysis, and variance commentary to corporate finance.

Team Leadership

• Lead and mentor AP, AR, and staff accounting teams.

• Establish SOPs, maintain service levels, and ensure cross-training for critical workflows.

Authority & Boundaries

• Controller Authority: Enforces accounting policies, close timelines, payment controls, and credit holds across operating entities.

• Corporate Ownership: Parent/holding company finance retains final authority over annual budgets, strategic pricing, capital allocation, M&A execution, and material credit limit exceptions.

Qualifications
Required

• Experience: 7+ years in progressive accounting, with 3+ years as Controller or Assistant Controller.

• Core Skills: Hands-on multi-entity month-end close, high-volume AP/AR management, 13-week cash forecasting, and customer credit administration.

• Technical: Strong US GAAP knowledge, internal control design, and advanced Excel.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

Working Conditions

トップラインを担うクォータ制メンバーとして、新規顧客への積極的なアプローチとセールス パイプラインの管理を行います。金融・銀行をはじめとする各業界の経営幹部や主要意思決定者と積極的に関わり、日本市場における当社の成長に直接貢献するとともに、カントリーディレクターと緊密に連携します。

使用技術スタック：HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, Phantombuster, Woodpecker, Aircall

勤務地：丸の内二重橋ビルディング https://share.google/OlRR71fi2tFFW620J (ハイブリッドワーキング/リモートファースト)

※商談の際はクライアント先へ訪問していただきますが、それ以外の通常業務は在宅勤務（リモートワーク）が可能です。

 

なぜIDEALSか？

- 営業担当者からの高い信頼：Idealsは営業プロフェッショナルによる評価で、RepVue https://www.repvue.com/companies/iDealsにおいて上位10％の企業にランクインしています。

- 成長の機会：G2 https://www.g2.com/categories/virtual-data-room?tab=highest_rated とUpGuard https://www.upguard.com/security-report/ideals-virtual-data-roomで最高評価を獲得した主力製品であるVDRで収益を4倍に拡大した、ブートストラップ方式のSaaS企業で成長を加速させましょう。

- 実績ある組織：17年以上のVDR事業実績、前年比30％超の収益成長、世界のM&A取引の10％以上を支える確立された組織の一員となれます。

 

主な業務内容

- 日本における主要ステークホルダーや業界インフルエンサーとの関係構築

- 新規顧客獲得に注力し、売上目標の達成

- 日本の戦略的アカウントと連携し、積極的にパイプラインを構築・管理するとともに、常に新たな機会を開拓

- 営業・マーケティング戦略の実行に積極的に貢献

- M&Aコミュニティイベントの企画運営に参加し、Idealsの認知度向上を図る

- 顧客に対する説得力のある製品プレゼンテーションを実施する

- 取引の構造化、交渉、成約を遂行する

- 顧客へのインサイト共有と進捗報告を継続的に行う

- 製品開発・管理チームへ適切な顧客フィードバックを提供する

- カスタマーサクセスおよびインサイドセールスと連携し、顧客満足度と企業収益の向上を図る

 

募集要項

- B2Bにおけるフル360度クロージング業務またはプロフェッショナルサービス分野での1-2年以上の実務経験

- IT, SaaS もしくは金融業界での経験

優遇条件

- C-suite（経営幹部層）とのコミュニケーション経験

- 高速販売環境での経験と、経営幹部層（C-Level）との高いコミュニケーション能力

- SaaS及びVDR（バーチャルデータルーム）業界での経験

- 上級レベルの英語力

 

当社が提供する環境

私たちは人材を最も重視しています。そのため、あなたの可能性を最大限に引き出すためのあらゆるリソースとサポートを提供します。

 

最高の仕事のために

ウェルビーイングのために

私たちの文化

詳細はこちら https://ideals.jobs/our-culture/.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
TL;DR - We’re looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

 

WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it.

As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function - from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production software

- Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development

- A track record of writing maintainable, well-tested code and owning what you build in production

- Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems

- Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

- Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users

- Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and end-to-end ownership

Bonus if you’ve:

- Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before

- Led zero-to-one product development

- Worked in a founding or early startup environment

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and problems

- Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems

- Design, code, test, deploy, and operate solutions across Lovable’s frontend and backend

- Translate insights from real usage into foundational platform improvements

- Own projects end-to-end-from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration

- Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries

- Shape how Forward Deployed Engineering operates at Lovable, including its engineering standa

Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

- Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

- Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai http://duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

- Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

- Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

- Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

ABOUT YOU

- You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

- You can do 2 or more of the following:

- Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

- Develop and deploy NLP solutions

- Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

- You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

- You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

- You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

- You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

COMPENSATION

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

- Help define the future of Legal Engineering.

- Experience leading managers and manager-led organizations, not solely individual contributors.

- Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing teams in complex, fast-paced environments.

- Experience owning organizational systems, processes, and operating models.

- Proven ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships and drive results across multiple stakeholders.

- Strong track record of managing upward and influencing senior leaders.

- Experience representing an organization externally and building trusted relationships with executive-level stakeholders.

- Deep understanding of law firms and enterprise legal teams, including corporate, litigation, investigations, regulatory, compliance, and legal operations functions, as well as the evolving legal technology landscape.

title: GTM Director, ASEAN

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

- Independently manage the full sales cycle from initiation to close - assisting some of the largest corporates and law firms in the world to succeed in the age of AI.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and legal teams to ensure our platform aligns with client needs and continues to develop at the highest pace.

- Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, addressing their pain points with tailored solutions.

- Contribute to the refinement of our account acquisition and management strategies and processes, documenting best practices to scale effectively.

- Demonstrate a founder-like mindset, tackling obstacles with initiative and creating scalable systems for growth.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. title: Assistant Controller
description:
Privia Health is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Assistant Controller to join our accounting team. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this key leadership role will be instrumental in scaling our financial operations, strengthening internal controls (SOX), driving key accounting workflows, and leading finance system transformations. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of public accounting and public company experience, with expertise in U.S. GAAP, audit readiness, and leading remote teams.
Primary Job Duties:
Financial Operations & Close Management

• Direct month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close routines to ensure accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements and reconciliations.

• Oversee the review of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules across business units.

• Partner with FP&A on budget-to-actual variance analyses and operational reporting to deliver actionable insights.

• Lead financial integration activities for mergers and acquisitions (M&A) to ensure seamless onboarding and accounting alignment.

• Direct or assist with specialized initiatives and projects as needed, demonstrating strong project management capabilities and a focus on enhancing operational processes.

• Technical Accounting, SEC Reporting & Governance

• Provide technical accounting guidance on complex transactions, including purchase accounting (ASC 805), revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and new accounting standards.

• Oversee the preparation of supporting accounting data, reconciliations, schedules, and technical input for SEC filings (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K) prepared by the Financial Reporting team.

• Maintain and monitor the company’s internal controls framework to ensure full SOX 404 compliance.

• Serve as a key liaison for external auditors, managing audit schedules, requests, and issue resolution.

• Systems, Transformation & Process Improvement

• Serve as the functional finance lead for the upcoming ERP transition, assisting with chart of accounts design, data migration, user acceptance testing (UAT), and workflow design.

• Identify and execute automation opportunities across existing financial software to streamline close cycles and operational routines.

• Treasury Operations

• Support operational treasury functions, including banking relationships, electronic fund transfers (ACH/wires), account structure administration, and positive pay management.
• Team Leadership & Development

• Manage, mentor, and foster accountability across a fully remote accounting team.

• Establish clear performance goals to foster continuous development and cross-functional alignment.

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
• Certification : Certified Public Accountant (CPA) required.
• Experience: 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, combining public accounting (Big 4 or large regional preferred) and public company environment experience.
• Background in healthcare, physician practice management, or health-tech environments preferred.
• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of U.S. GAAP, SOX 404 compliance, internal controls design, and the management of internal and external audit engagements.
• Leadership: Proven track record of hiring, managing, and developing remote accounting professionals.
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across executive leadership, IT, HR, and external auditors.
• Systems: Experience with Workday Financials and/or Microsoft Dynamics highly preferred.
• Specialized Skills: Direct experience with enterprise ERP implementations, income tax provision oversight, or corporate treasury operations highly preferred.

As every organization shifts towards automated processes, cloud technologies, and DevOps methodologies - experience in these spaces becomes increasingly important. The ideal Accelerator Architect can demonstrate to developers and cloud teams how PAM increases security posture, streamlines processes, and is able to document patterns and blueprints to provide compelling solutions in this space.

title: Principal/Staff Security Engineer
description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale - powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: UK (occasional travel to data centre and test environments, confirm exact cadence) | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: VP Information Security

We're looking for a Principal/ Staff Security Engineer to join Infosec, reporting to our VP InfoSec. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will need a deep, technical understanding of Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls to manage our production environment.

As we move toward owning and operating more of our own data centre footprint, the accuracy of our firewall policies, network access controls and technical security testing matters more than ever. This role will build our internal penetration testing capability, so testing becomes more targeted and accurate over time, working alongside our external testers rather than replacing them. You will need to work proactively across engineering teams so knowledge does not sit with one person alone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SECURITY TESTING & AUDIT:

- Audit firewall policies and network access controls across the estate.

- Conduct internal penetration testing, working alongside our external penetration testing partners.

- Build a penetration testing strategy and cadence that improves accuracy and coverage over time.

- Identify and help remediate security gaps found through testing and audit.

PRODUCTION ESTATE & TECHNICAL DEPTH:

- Build and maintain a deep, working understanding of our production environment, including Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls.

- Investigate technical issues directly and dig into root cause, rather than relying on reported findings alone.

- Support the VP Infosec on controls testing across the Production Estate.

ACCESS & ENVIRONMENT MANAGEMENT:

- Own and maintain SSO and systems access configuration.

- Build and maintain penetration testing environments, including small Kubernetes clusters as needed.

- Maintain the tooling and infrastructure supporting security testing.

COLLABORATION:

- Work proactively across engineering teams to avoid becoming a single point of knowledge or failure.

- Document processes, findings and configurations so knowledge is shared, not siloed.

- Partner with the Head of Security Operations on shared governance, risk reporting and security testing.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Strong Kubernetes experience, with the technical depth to investigate and resolve issues directly.

- Experience auditing firewall policies and network access controls.

- Experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing.

- Comfortable maintaining and operating security tooling and environments on an ongoing basis.

- Strong written communication skills, given the solo nature

ABOUT THE ROLE

The PeopleOps Coordinator supports daily HR operations, with a focus on employee benefits, onboarding, records, and employee questions. This role works closely with employees, benefit providers, payroll, and leadership to keep processes accurate, timely, and easy to understand.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

Benefits administration

- Coordinate employee enrollment, changes, and terminations for medical, dental, vision, life, disability, retirement, and other benefit plans.

- Support annual open enrollment, including employee communications and information sessions.

- Review benefit and payroll data for accuracy and resolve discrepancies.

- Respond to employee questions about coverage, eligibility, claims, and qualifying life events.

- Work with benefit brokers, insurance carriers, and other vendors.

- Maintain required notices and documentation.

- Support COBRA administration, leave coordination, and benefits reporting.

People Operations

- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, including paperwork, system access, benefit enrollment, and exit documentation.

- HRIS and systems ownership, such as maintaining accurate employee data, troubleshooting workflow issues, and coordinating system updates with vendors.

- Prepare standard HR reports and complete employment verification requests.

- Help document and improve HR procedures.

- Provide administrative support for employee programs, audits, and compliance activities.

Employee support

- Serve as a primary point of contact for routine HR and benefits inquiries, providing timely responses and escalating complex issues appropriately.

- Explain policies and benefits in clear, practical language.

- Handle employee information with discretion.

- Route sensitive or complex matters to the appropriate HR team member.

What success looks like

During the first six months, the coordinator should:

- Process benefit and employee changes accurately and on time.

- Give employees clear, consistent answers or find the right answer quickly.

- Maintain complete and reliable HR records.

- Build productive working relationships with payroll and benefit vendors.

- Identify recurring errors or questions and improve the related process or communication.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 2-4 years of experience in HR coordination, benefits administration, payroll support, or a related role.

- Working knowledge of employee benefits and common HR processes.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Clear written and verbal communication.

- Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.

- Experience with HRIS, payroll, benefits, or applicant-tracking systems.

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, email, and document-management tools.

- Ability to manage several deadlines without losing accuracy.

- Preferred
